implementation: frozen v1 no-Jev EMER + one bounded explicit-longview correction coefficient
development_source: core-choice-v1 train and validation only; its old test is excluded

training.selection: same search budget; each arm selects maximum weighted validation mean NDCG@3 across six positive goals; earliest ties
training.posterior: number of six positive feedback bits minus explicit hate bit
training.prior: seven frozen behavior probabilities oriented to utility; Jev adds inputs only
training.advantage: per-slate previous-epoch/current Mean@3 ratios on frozen behavior utilities; epsilon 1e-6
training.sample_weights: inverse inclusion weights normalized to training mean one

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: paired user clusters, averaged over fixed fitted seeds
evaluation.success: primary lower 95% CI > 0 and primary point gain > 0 in every seed, positive-goal mean lower CI >= 0, click lower CI >= -0.005, hate-risk increase upper CI <= 0.005

latency.scope: ready numeric tensors through scores and sorting; feature lookup and Jev production excluded and reported separately

gate: Do not prepare or score April23 until corrected residual April22 development passes all five effect conditions.
